bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
w=/home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015
b=$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)
case "$b" in 53838af6ea54357daf328157cb603b54fc4e0eac|8e2f480db00faf20a51e463d4a05fe94c4dbeb49|cd84ad051dac40583ff1e3c2370d6c621f3cb530) :;; *) exit 72;; esac
test -z "$(git -C "$w" status --porcelain --untracked-files=all)" || exit 73
git -C "$w" fetch --no-tags origin feat/per-model-lifecycle-20261013 >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = cd84ad051dac40583ff1e3c2370d6c621f3cb530 || exit 74
test "$b" = cd84ad051dac40583ff1e3c2370d6c621f3cb530 || git -C "$w" checkout --detach -q cd84ad051dac40583ff1e3c2370d6c621f3cb530
rc=0
out=$(docker run --rm --network none --cpus 1 --memory 512m -v "$w:/src:ro" -w /src -e PYTHONPATH=/src --entrypoint python3 ai-core-model-gate:offline-01ef4da9 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_model_gate.py -k opt_in_18080_compatibility -v 2>&1) || rc=$?
msg="AI_CORE_18080_SOURCE_REGRESSION HEAD=cd84ad051dac40583ff1e3c2370d6c621f3cb530 EXIT=$rc $(printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -E '^Ran |^OK$|^FAILED ' | tr '\n' ';')"
gh api -X POST repos/seigo-gace/ai-core/issues/1/comments -f body="$msg" --jq .html_url >/dev/null
echo "AI_CORE_COMPAT_TEST_EXIT=$rc"
exit "$rc"
